Title: Public preview: Elastic and Azure Spring Cloud integration

Body.Content:
Integrate Azure Spring Cloud logs and application performance management (APM) data into Elastic. Then access any type of data from anywhere: on-premises, multicloud, or hybrid cloud environments. This holistic view streamlines migrating your Spring Boot applications to the cloud.

Elastic Cloud handles the security, maintenance, and upkeep, allowing you to drive your business forward with increased visibility, improved operations, and resiliency. Teams can also correlate and add context to their Spring Boot data with other observability data sets across their environments for end-to-end monitoring.

Resources:

  • Monitor applications
  • Analyze logs and metrics
